brief.t: START HERE: Pull the Polo 4PL invoice for container EMCU8614105, verify whether it was paid, and send the receipt so clearance can begin.

ACT NOW 1: Clearance and release for container EMCU8614105 remain unverified because PLL has not confirmed the Polo 4PL invoice payment or receipt in the available sources. 4PL Accounting is waiting; no stated deadline, and the blocker has remained open 1 calendar day since it surfaced. Send: Erik, I am confirming the invoice payment and will send the receipt. Please confirm clearance and the pickup ETA once duties are paid.

ACT NOW 2: Kenna's Et-VC package forwarding remains unverified 18 calendar days after its reported September 16 delivery. Mel is waiting; no stated deadline. Send: Mel, I am locating the Et-VC package and will send the forwarding tracking and status today.

ACT NOW 3: FSS order 162946 is paid and expected to receive expedited handling tomorrow, October 5, but dispatch and tracking remain unverified. PLL is waiting on the raw material; 0 days overdue. Send: Phillip, please confirm tomorrow's expedited dispatch and send tracking.

next: Recommendation: Resolve the Polo 4PL payment receipt first because the container cannot advance to clearance or release without it.
Scheduled: At least 2 supplier milestones are dated. The nearest is the FSS expedite tomorrow, October 5; ActivePeptide is scheduled to ship October 6.
Noise: 12 exact-window Outlook items surfaced, none urgent; exact mailbox totals are unavailable.

Source gaps: CRM browser session signed out. WhatsApp Web signed out. Purchasing replied that it has no current operational records to verify open supplier or production risks. Email reported no substantive drafts or qualifying overdue threads.
signal: Polo 4PL container release, Kenna package forwarding, and FSS raw-material dispatch remain the clearest operational and revenue-protection signals.
redflags: Container EMCU8614105 cannot proceed to clearance and release until payment is confirmed and the receipt is sent.
The Et-VC package has lacked verified forwarding status for 18 days since reported delivery.
CRM and WhatsApp were unavailable for this run.
